family_reports.body: This system that was intended to "protect" children ultimately put my children into the hands of real abusers. My oldest son and daughter were forced to destroy items that they brought with them (security baby blanket, stuffed animals etc), they were punished for speaking positive about me and praised for anything negative. To this day my son still suffers from the trauma he endured.
Family Court is the battlefield of psychological warfare. They are causing lifetime traumas with no accountability or oversight!
